⚠️ **The 304/557 is not a per-component number.** Child slots are `z.union([SchemaNodeSchema, z.array(SchemaNodeSchema)])` and `SchemaNodeSchema` resolves to `BaseSchemaCore` — the ~21 base keys and nothing type-specific — so strict-ifying the recursion point unrecognises every child node's own declared props.
